evals.name: embed-react-widget-into-express-host
evals.prompt: I run an existing Express app (Node) and I have a separately deployed React widget hosted at https://reviews.acme.dev. I want to embed that widget as a micro-frontend on my /products page using the web-fragments library. Show me everything I need: the gateway setup, the middleware, the client bootstrap, and where the element goes.
evals.expected_output: Uses FragmentGateway + registerFragment with fragmentId/endpoint/routePatterns (asset pattern + /products host route), getNodeMiddleware from web-fragments/gateway/node, initializeWebFragments() in client bootstrap, and a <web-fragment fragment-id> on the /products page. Must NOT import web-fragments/middleware and must use registerFragment not register.

assertions.text: registerFragment config includes fragmentId, endpoint, and routePatterns
routePatterns include both an asset pattern (e.g. /__wf/...) and the /products host route
Calls initializeWebFragments() in the client bootstrap
Places a <web-fragment fragment-id="..."> element on the /products page
Does NOT import from 'web-fragments/middleware' (non-existent entry point)

evals.name: debug-blank-fragment-asset-404
evals.prompt: I'm using web-fragments. My fragment renders blank on the host page and the browser console shows the fragment's JS and CSS files returning 404 under /__wf/. The host page itself loads fine and the fragment app works when I open its own URL directly. The fragment is a Vite app. What's going wrong and how do I fix it?
evals.expected_output: Identifies the asset-path vs routePattern mismatch as the root cause: the fragment's Vite build.assetsDir must share the same /__wf/<unique>/ prefix as the gateway's asset routePattern. Gives a concrete fix aligning the two. Does not invent unrelated causes.

assertions.text: Identifies asset path / routePattern prefix mismatch as the root cause
References Vite build.assetsDir alignment with the /__wf/ asset routePattern
Gives a concrete corrective step (edit assetsDir or routePattern so prefixes match)
Does not hallucinate an unrelated root cause (e.g. CORS, missing fragment-id) as primary

evals.name: author-fragment-and-register-on-cloudflare
evals.prompt: Create a brand-new web fragment from scratch: a small standalone 'newsletter-signup' app. Then show me how to register and serve it from my host app, which is deployed on Cloudflare Pages.
evals.expected_output: A standalone fragment app that does NOT import web-fragments, with a unique Vite build.assetsDir under __wf/. Host registration uses FragmentGateway + registerFragment with a matching asset routePattern, and Cloudflare Pages middleware uses getWebMiddleware from web-fragments/gateway (Web, not Node) in a functions/_middleware.ts onRequest handler.

assertions.text: The fragment app does NOT import the web-fragments package (it's a plain standalone app)
Sets a unique Vite build.assetsDir under __wf/ for the fragment
Uses getWebMiddleware from 'web-fragments/gateway' (Web runtime), NOT getNodeMiddleware
Cloudflare Pages wiring uses functions/_middleware.ts with an onRequest handler
registerFragment asset routePattern prefix matches the fragment's assetsDir
